newsitem.title: UK: MISYS up on H1 results, upbeat forecast.
newsitem.headline: MISYS up on H1 results, upbeat forecast.

text.p: Shares in MISYS Plc firmed on Wednesday after the UK software applications group reported profit growth in the first six months of its fiscal year and issued an upbeat forecast, dealers said.
The shares were up 7-1/2p at 1125 at 0833 GMT.

MISYS posted pre-tax profits of 23.7 million stg for the six months ended November 30, 1996, up from 19.2 million in the year ago period, and said it expected further progress with strong order books.
The company also issued a dividend of 4.57p per share.
